rows.title: Comparison asks are recognized

rows.test: "am I spending more than usual" and six more are a comparison

rows.test: "more than the average american" and "how did last month compare" are not answered

rows.defect: today is read in UTC

rows.test: a Starbucks row dated Oct 13 counts on Oct 12 in New York

rows.defect: last month is cut at the same day number even past its end
rows.test: Mar 31 against Feb 1-28, said as day 31 vs day 28

rows.title: The first day of a month
rows.defect: a one-day range is said as "Oct 1-1"
rows.test: Oct 1 against Sep 1, said as single days

rows.title: The average by the same day
rows.defect: the by-day average uses whole months
rows.test: $200.33 by day 12 over Jul-Sep

rows.title: Only full months on file

rows.test: history from Oct 5 says there is nothing to compare with

rows.defect: refunds are ignored

rows.title: Transfers and card payments never count
rows.defect: every debit counts as spending
rows.test: the $500.00 transfer and the $300.00 card payment stay out

rows.title: Pending said, not added
rows.defect: pending charges are added
rows.test: a dated $28.50 pending DoorDash stays out of $432.99

rows.title: Other currencies never added
rows.defect: a EUR charge is added as dollars
rows.test: a 30.00 EUR charge stays out of $432.99

rows.title: Uncategorized said apart
rows.defect: uncategorized spending is listed as a category change

rows.title: A named category narrows it
rows.defect: the category in the ask is ignored

rows.title: The three biggest changes
rows.defect: only two changes are shown
rows.test: groceries, restaurants, gas; a $5.00 transport change is fourth

rows.title: Top 3 places per card
rows.defect: only two places are shown per card

rows.title: Never a full number

rows.title: A card named the person's way
rows.defect: issuer nicknames are not matched

rows.title: The period asked
rows.defect: every ask is answered for this month

rows.title: Which card carries the most
rows.defect: the most-used card is not named

rows.title: Card asks only

rows.defect: the source line is dropped from the comparison
